summary: Well-structured test suite with comprehensive coverage of main requirements across three levels: unit tests (40+ cases), workflow structure tests (13 cases), and integration tests (3 act-push scenarios). Strong points: good semantic versioning edge cases, clear separation of concerns, independent sandboxed tests, end-to-end validation via act, excellent test naming and organization. Gaps: ConvertFrom-ConventionalCommit and Resolve-VersionFile lack direct unit tests (only indirect coverage); some functions minimally tested (Get-CommitMessages has 1 test); error scenarios focus on missing-file cases but miss malformed input validation, build metadata handling, and 0.0.0 edge cases; CLI entry point (bump-version.ps1) only tested through act, not directly; no test for BREAKING-CHANGE (hyphenated) as explicit separate case. Act tests limited to 3 cases (though representative). Sufficient to catch most regressions in happy paths and main bump scenarios, but some edge cases and error paths could slip through.
